newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian panel urges disinvestment in three firms. [Corrected 13:09 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Indian panel urges disinvestment in three firms. [Corrected 13:09 GMT]

text.p: India's Disinvestment Commission said on Wednesday that it has recommended that the government sell part of its equity stakes in three companies.(Corrects number of companies from four to three)
The Commission, in its fourth report, said it wanted the government to sell partial stakes in Hindustan Copper Ltd, Pawan Hans Helicopters Ltd and the Shipping Corp of India Ltd.

(corrects to erase reference to Power Grid Corp of India Ltd; to make clear that the panel did not recommend disinvestment in Power Grid Corp of India Ltd.) The government sold 19.88 percent of its shares in SCI in two tranches in 1992/93 (April-March) and 1993/94.
The Commission's recommendation is not binding on the government.
